### Description
Please provide a brief summary of the changes in this pull request. Include context and any relevant background information.

### Checklist

#### Code Quality
- [ ] Is the code clearly commented?
- [ ] Does it conform to PEP8 style guide?
- [ ] Are variable and function names descriptive?
- [ ] Are docstrings added to new functions and classes?

#### Model Development
- [ ] Is the model architecture clearly defined and documented?
- [ ] Are the model parameters and hyperparameters justified?
- [ ] Is the data preprocessing pipeline clearly defined and documented?
- [ ] Are performance metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall) reported?
- [ ] Are any performance improvements or degradations explained?

#### Testing
- [ ] Are unit tests added for new functions and classes?
- [ ] Are integration tests added for new modules?
- [ ] Are regression tests added to ensure existing functionality is not broken?

#### Review and Approval
- [ ] Code reviewed by at least one peer
- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed and approved by at least one peer
